description: Sky Raiders: Машины в Небе — polished Angry Birds style physics launcher with cars, using existing MiniMax PNG/MP3 assets. Must visibly draw assets/background.png, assets/title.png and assets/sprites.png with ctx.drawImage for background, cars, enemies, buildings and menu. No rectangle-only actors. 3 levels, 4 vehicle types, mouse/touch catapult, Space ability, M music, R restart, rich destruction, particles, camera follow, longer replayable gameplay.
title: Sky Raiders: Машины в Небе

images.prompt: wide gameplay background with depth, environment layers, cinematic composition, rich details, usable behind a canvas game. Game title: Sky Raiders: Машины в Небе. User request: Sky Raiders: Машины в Небе — Angry Birds style physics launcher with cars instead of birds. Player pulls back a slingshot/catapult with mouse/touch, releases to launch a car. Cars fly with physics, rotate, collide and destroy structures. CRITICAL: game MUST use generated PNG assets via Image() and ctx.drawImage(), NOT simple fillRect shapes. Asset pipeline: generate backgrounds, car sprites, enemy/building sprites, title art FIRST, then use them in HTML via ctx.drawImage. 4 car types: small fast red car, heavy truck that punches through walls, police car that accelerates on Space in flight, van that creates shockwave on impact. 3 levels: suburban with wooden garages, night parking lot with metal structures, city rooftops with neon signs. Physics: gravity, trajectory, rotation, block destruction, collisions, impulse, particles, camera following flying car, camera return after turn. Enemies are cartoon mechanic bandits drawn as sprites (NOT circles/squares) on structures. Controls: mouse/touch drag and release catapult, Space activate car ability in flight, R restart level, Enter start/next level, M toggle music. Visual: large adaptive canvas, parallax backgrounds, real car sprites, beautiful destruction, smoke/sparks/dust particles, trajectory trail, screen shake on hard hits, car selection UI, score, level, remaining cars counter. Sound: local music theme plays after start, slingshot tension sound, launch sound, impact, destruction, explosion, victory, defeat. States: start menu, gameplay, level victory, final victory, game over, restart. NO simple rectangles/circles for cars/enemies/background. All assets must be local PNGs loaded via Image(), drawn via ctx.drawImage().. Theme: neon. High quality game art, clear readable shapes, no UI text, no watermarks.
